changelog:
Initial release of officecli—AI-friendly CLI for Office documents.

- Create, inspect, proofread, and modify .docx, .xlsx, and .pptx files with a single CLI tool.
- Includes detailed help system and command references for all supported document types.
- Supports document viewing (outline, stats, issues, text, HTML, etc.), editing, and querying with CSS-like selectors.
- Features live preview/watch mode with browser-based interactive selection.
- Enables high performance via resident mode to minimize file I/O.
- No dependencies or Office installation required—single binary install for all major platforms.
summary: Create, analyze, proofread, and modify Office documents (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) using the officecli CLI tool. Use when the user wants to create, inspect, check...
